description: Verify that FindService(specific instance) returns OfferService with that one entry
approach:
[Objective]
FindService(specific instance) returns OfferService with that one entry.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message (OfferService / Subscribe Ack / Nack). The harness captures it and validates the asserted property byte-precisely.

[Pass condition]
The asserted property holds on the wire.

[Fail condition]
Fail_<state> per the listed verdicts; Fail_timeout if no qualifying SD message arrived.

verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer_for_instance_1: No single-entry offer for instance_id 1 within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_offer_for_instance_2: No single-entry offer for instance_id 2 within listen window
